scope: Deterministic, browser-local English-language lexical triage of user-supplied legislative or regulatory text into six configured categories: obligations, prohibitions, deadlines, thresholds, public authority, and enforcement.
jurisdictionPolicyBoundary: The lexical rules are jurisdiction-neutral and do not retrieve or identify governing law. The user must supply the complete official text and a qualified reviewer must establish jurisdiction, version, enactment and effective status, amendments, definitions, cross-references, and controlling authority.
prohibitedInference: A match does not identify a complete clause, actor, covered person, exception, deadline calculation, threshold operation, enforceability, applicability, legal effect, risk, or compliance result. No configured match is an abstention, not clearance.

knownLimitations: The synthetic corpus evaluates configured English-language lexical behavior, not legal interpretation or real-world completeness.
The tool does not retrieve official text, identify jurisdiction or version, follow definitions or cross-references, compare amendments, or determine enactment or effective status.
The lexicon cannot reliably understand negation, quotation, exceptions, scope, implied duties, technical synonyms, drafting conventions, or surrounding context.
Matches list configured terms rather than extracting complete clauses, actors, dates, quantities, or remedies.
Legal effect, applicability, deadlines, thresholds, enforcement posture, and compliance remain outside scope.
retestTrigger: Any lexicon, matching logic, category, review question, output field, jurisdiction boundary, prohibited-inference boundary, or public capability claim change; otherwise 2026-11-01.
